# pagefeather.dev

> WordPress and WooCommerce on Cloudflare, in your own Cloudflare account.
> Open source. No hosted funnel. You keep the tokens, the data, and the bill.

## Product
- Site: https://www.pagefeather.dev/
- Engine source: https://github.com/skyphusion-labs/pagefeather
- Marketing theme: https://github.com/skyphusion-labs/pagefeather-dev

- How it works: https://www.pagefeather.dev/how-it-works/
- Limits: https://www.pagefeather.dev/limits/
- Evidence: https://www.pagefeather.dev/evidence/
- About: https://www.pagefeather.dev/about/
- Live store example: https://ggc.sh

## Paths
- b-dosql: PHP and SQLite in one Durable Object (Workers Free or Paid)
- Approach A: PHP in a Worker, MySQL through Hyperdrive (Workers Paid; real WooCommerce stores)
- Many sites: Workers for Platforms
